resources.string: Scrolls down to the next reel or page
Goes back to the previous one
Works when Air actions › Press and hold Pen button is set to Pen Scroll. Pen button clicks stay with Samsung.
Scroll any app with your S Pen button

Pen Scroll only performs a single action, such as a swipe, a double tap, Back or Home, when you trigger it (for example from S Pen Air actions). It does not read, store or send any screen content. If you turn on the volume-key option, it also turns volume up/down into scrolls while Instagram is open.
Turn on Pen Scroll in Accessibility settings
Samsung may stop the service in the background. Turn off battery optimization.

string-array.name: setup_steps
string-array.item: Android 13+ blocks Accessibility for sideloaded apps. Go to Settings > Apps > Pen Scroll > three-dot menu (top right) > \"Allow restricted settings\".
Settings > Accessibility > Installed apps > Pen Scroll > turn on.
Settings > Apps > Pen Scroll > Battery > Unrestricted (so Samsung doesn\'t kill it).
Settings > Advanced features > S Pen > Air actions > Press and hold Pen button > choose Pen Scroll.
Open Instagram Reels and press and hold the pen button.
